decisions_requiring_human_review: Review exact exchanges and opening setup limitations; assign interpretation, response and authority separately with uncertain/not evaluated where unsupported.

recommended_next_step: Stop and await human review. Score only supported criteria; retain original/continuation version provenance and separate historical partial S04.
